Mistress '''Andscale''' is one of the two most prominent bankers in [[Caemlyn]]; she agrees to lend [[Elayne]] much-needed money when Elayne discovers alum on one of her estates.

She also provided the money [[Arymilla Marne|Arymilla]] used to bribe the mercenaries guarding the wall of Caemlyn to turn coat.
